items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: But Art and I was hanging out, we'd make these after-hour spots

ctx.x: And we used to get together, and Art, he always liked to go to these after-hour places. And because this same guy down at Downbeat wanted Art to do a session for him, and Art was going to do a session for him, but I've forgotten -- they didn't get together on the bread. And Art said, well, I don't think I'll fool with it.

But Art and I was hanging out, we'd make these after-hour spots, and you know how Art is, he hates to go home. Art will hate to go home, so a lot of times I would be driving for him. So I said, Art, man, it's 4:00 in the morning, they're going to shoot us. Aw, that's all right, that's all right, it's early yet.
So sometimes we'd get home 5:00 or 6:00 in the morning. So I parked the car and get Art to the front door and say, see you later, take off.
